import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Set up the figure
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))

# Create a count plot of dog breeds
sns.countplot(data=data, y='Rasse1Text', order=data['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().index, palette='viridis')

# Add labels and title
plt.title('Distribution of Dog Breeds in Zurich', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Dog Breeds', fontsize=12)

# Save the figure

import pandas as pd

# Set up the figure

# Add labels and title
